messages:
sam (sales): heads-up — incoming from a large healthcare prospect asking to combine an annual committed package with per-token top-ups for burst usage. they want predictable monthly spend but the ability to spike during campaigns. attached notes from the call.

marta (product): can you paste the key asks from the call? are they asking for true credits (prepaid) or a blended billing model?

sam (sales): main points:
- 1yr committed spend for Dedicated capacity for baseline (predictable throughput)
- during certain months they run patient outreach campaigns and want per-token top-ups against their committed capacity instead of paying for extra reserved GPUs
- they asked if we can do a redeemable credit pool for top-ups that decays monthly
- compliance is HUGE (HIPAA) so Private deployment likely

kai (support): from support side — need clarity on metering. if top-ups are token-based we must ensure audit logs show which model/route consumed the top-up credits for SOC reports.

kevin (finance): high level — two options:
1) prepaid credit pool that is consumed by tokens; any unused at month end rolls to next month but expires at contract end
2) blended effective rate where we compute a monthly blended per-token price based on committed baseline + estimated spike %
Both have accounting implications. option 1 looks like deferred revenue we can amortize; option 2 changes invoicing complexity.

marta (product): questions for sales -> what launch criteria do they need? is a PoC acceptable (Private dev deployment) or do they require GA-level SLA for go-live? also need to know expected spike magnitude and frequency.

sam (sales): they want SLA-level for baseline (99.9) and softer SLOs for bursts. PoC ok if it's within their environment and passes security review. spike estimate: 2x baseline for ~3 months a year, unpredictable windows.

leah (eng): engineering concerns: mixing token credits with Dedicated GPU pools is doable but requires mapping token consumption to a billing meter separate from capacity-based metering. we can add a tagging layer on requests: `billing.tier: baseline|topup` and emit metering events. engineering estimate: ~2 sprints to add tagging+reporting, plus 1 sprint for private-deploy test. :gear:

kai (support): also need a clear customer-facing UX for showing remaining top-up credits and per-route usage. ops-bot: please create a ticket for metrics/dashboard.

ops-bot: ticket created: INF-4823 — "Credit pool metering + UI for committed + top-up usage" (assign: eng/oncall)

marta (product): proposal draft for triage:
- short term (PoC): implement tagging + basic reporting, offer prepaid credit pool (monthly purchased top-ups). no auto-rollover. target: pilot in 6 weeks.
- medium term (GA): add optional rollover rules, expiry controls, and blended-rate invoicing for enterprise accounts. include audit logs and model-level attribution. target: Q3 release if prioritized.

kevin (finance): for pilot we should avoid complex amortization. recommend prepaid monthly top-ups invoiced up-front. GA can expand to multi-month credit bundles.

sam (sales): customer update: they're ok with pilot but want written notes on launch criteria: security sign-off, billing transparency, and an SLA appendix for baseline. can product/eng capture acceptance criteria?

marta (product): acceptance criteria (draft):
- billing: token-level ledger that attributes consumption to either `baseline` or `topup` (audit-ready)
- visibility: UI showing current credit pool and last 30 days usage per route
- reliability: baseline capacity meets 99.9 uptime; top-ups best-effort with clear SLOs
- security: deployment runs within their VPC/private deployment and passes our SOC checklist
- docs: clear contract language and example invoice

leah (eng): will add a short RFC with proposed tagging schema and telemetry events. estimate: 10 dev-days + 5 QA-days.

marta (product): ok — I'm going to prioritize a small spike for the PoC in next planning slice. sam, schedule pilot kickoff with the customer after we have RFC and initial dashboard mock.

sam (sales): will do. thanks all. :thumbsup:

kevin (finance): FYI — will prepare a simple pilot invoice template. run it by legal for compliance phrasing.

kai (support): looping in support docs owner to draft customer-facing FAQ about how credit pools work.

marta (product): next steps summary:
- leah: RFC + telemetry PR (due in 7 days)
- eng: quick dashboard mock for pilot (7 days)
- finance: pilot invoice draft (7 days)
- sam: schedule kickoff once above done
- support: FAQ draft (10 days)

sam (sales): copied. I'll follow up with the customer tomorrow and aim to get PoC NDA signed.

ops-bot: reminder set: follow-up in 7 days for RFC status.

marta (product): thanks team — marking this for triage into product backlog. will add a discovery ticket with acceptance criteria and estimated effort. :white_check_mark:
